edit.title: Edit page
edit.purposeHint: Why this page exists at all.
edit.stoppedAtHint: The exact point you stopped, so you can pick the thread back up.
edit.lastDecisionHint: A decision worth not re-arguing later.
edit.outcomeHint: What it looks like when this is finished.
edit.afterThatHint: The step after the next one.

quickSave.title: Quick save
quickSave.name: What is it
quickSave.noteHint: One line now saves ten minutes of guessing in six months. No preview is fetched from the link.

training.title: Training
training.lead: Where the training actually stands: what is next, what was last, and which plan is running.
training.emptyHint: Add one and every session you log will show up here.
training.noPlanDetail: No details were written for this plan.

notes.pickTemplate: Start from a blank note, or from one of these:

idea.title: The idea
idea.hint: Describe the general idea and the result you are aiming at.

process.title: The process
process.hint: List the steps, in the order you mean to do them.

state.title: Where it stands
state.hint: Where the project is right now, and what is already done.

stuck.title: Where it is stuck
stuck.hint: What is holding this up — a supplier, a decision you have not made, something that might slow it down later.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.hint: Decisions worth not re-arguing in six months.

measurements.title: Measurements and numbers
measurements.hint: Sizes, quantities, model numbers — whatever you keep having to look up.

budget.title: Budget
budget.hint: What this is expected to cost, and what has been spent.

toCheck.title: Ideas to look into
toCheck.hint: Things worth checking before you commit to them.

notes.title: Notes

images.visionTitle: The picture you are aiming at
images.addressHint: A direct link to an image. Only the address is stored — never the picture itself.
images.pageLink: Or a page with no picture of its own
images.pageLinkHint: A Pinterest board, for instance. It is kept as a link and shown as one — no thumbnail is invented for it.

learning.title: Learning
learning.lead: What you are learning, where you stopped, and everything you saved along the way.
learning.emptyHint: A learning page keeps the level you are at, where you stopped, your plan, and the links, documents, pictures and videos you collected.
learning.levelScope: Showing this level plus anything filed as general.
learning.goal: Where I want to get to
learning.imageHint: The address of a picture. Only the address is stored — never the file.
learning.planHint: A list you tick off. You write it yourself; nothing is generated, and no template from anywhere else in Focus belongs here.
learning.foreignList: This list came from a template that belongs to another part of Focus — a shopping list, a packing list or an event. It is not a study plan.
learning.foreignListConfirm: The list will be removed from this learning page. Nothing else is affected.
learning.noLms: No lessons, no grades, no tests. This is a page about something you are learning, not a course.

stoppedAt.title: Where I stopped
stoppedAt.hint: The point you want to pick up from next time.

plan.title: Study plan
plan.hint: The route you mean to take, or the steps in the order you want them.

nextSteps.title: Next steps
nextSteps.hint: What you want to do once the current stage is behind you.

remember.title: Worth remembering
remember.hint: Rules, phrases and corrections you keep having to look up.

material.title: Material
material.emptyAtLevel: Nothing saved at this level yet.
material.documentsNote: Focus stores a link to the document, not the file itself. There is no upload and nothing is kept on this device beyond the address.
material.name: Name
material.imageHint: The preview is the check: if it does not load, the address is wrong.

whyRead.title: Why I wanted to read it
whyRead.hint: Where the recommendation came from, or what drew you to it.

stoppedAt.title: Where I stopped
stoppedAt.hint: Chapter, page, or just what was happening.

ideas.title: Ideas worth keeping
ideas.hint: The parts you would want to find again.

summary.title: What I made of it
summary.hint: In your own words, once you have finished.

whyWatch.title: Why I wanted to see it
whyWatch.hint: Who recommended it, or what caught your eye.

thoughts.title: What I thought
thoughts.hint: Worth writing down before it fades.

recommendTo.title: Who to recommend it to
recommendTo.hint: And who would definitely not enjoy it.

whyGo.title: Why go
whyGo.hint: What makes this worth the journey.

placesThere.title: Places to see there
placesThere.hint: The ones you would be sorry to miss.

worthKnowing.title: Worth knowing
worthKnowing.hint: Opening times, seasons, the thing nobody tells you.

prosCons.title: Pros and cons
prosCons.hint: What you found out, on both sides.

checkedSoFar.title: What I have checked
checkedSoFar.hint: So you do not repeat the research next year.

whatItIs.title: What it is
whatItIs.hint: Enough to remember the idea later.
